main_text.p: pacem folidam ecclefiæ & regni ftabiliendam excogitari potuerunt, 2. Quia non deftiterunt arces regias ufque adeo follicitè cuftodire ut nihil apparatus bellici, aut alterius cujuflibet neceffarii, inferri permittant. 3. Quia illicitos conventus cogant, ac novum tribunal Edenburgi erexerint, in manifestum summæ authoritatis ac legum contemptum.4. Quod ex deputatis fuere quidam in Hibernia, & Scotia censuris ecclefiafticis notati, alii à minifterii functione legitimè suspensi, alii ad minifterium illegitimè promoti, omnes denique juramento constricti ad regiminis Episcopalis subversionem. 5. Quia liberæ delegandorum ad synodum electioni præscripserunt; privatim ubique monentes & jubentes, ut prætermissis iis qui animitus non favè[?]rent omnibus ipsorum consiliis ii soli deputarentur; de quorum zelo constaret. 6. Quia Glasguam advenerunt locum Synodo præstitutum armis lege vetitis accincti, ac comitatu frequentissimo, nulla habita edicti illa speciali[?]ter vetantis ratione. 7. Quia peremptorie abnuerint sex assessoribus à rege designatis, jus suffragii definitivi. 8. Quia obstinatè renuebant ne Episcoporum protestatio prælegeretur, ante præsidis electionem & literarum fidei examinationem. 9. Quod regia declaratione registris Synodicis ad perpetuam memoriam inserta, non contenti, eo collimarent omnia ipsorum consilia, ut Episcopatum ipsum penitùs everterent, adeoque tertium ordinum regni membrum amputarent: & fundamentales regni leges refigerent: Quæ cum manifestum Monarchici regiminis damnum secum trahant, ejusmodi conventui non potuisse Deputatum Marchionem diutius interesse; ideoque inde discessisse, 28. Novemb. quando licet anxiè rogitasset, ut actionem illam precibus clauderent, pollicitus, se die crastino rediturum ut responsurum ec-rundem

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "favèrent" (the letter after "fav" is blurred and may be a ligature or accent) and "speciali[?]ter" (the joining of the word is unclear). The left margin strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is omitted. The small mark below the text is not a clear gathering signature and is omitted. The printed long s is rendered as a plain s throughout; where the scan shows an s-like form, the text has been given as printed. The word "Glafguam" is printed as such. The final word of the page is "ec-rundem" (the word continues over the line end, "eorundem" as the sense requires, but only "ec-" and "rundem" are printed here).
